prompt: This is a fictional research QA fixture, not real compounds or patient advice. Interpret this supplied ADMET screening result without launching a workflow: C001 predicted hERG IC50=0.2 micromolar, predicted unbound Cmax=0.1 micromolar; C002 predicted hERG IC50=20 micromolar, predicted unbound Cmax=0.1 micromolar. Compute IC50/Cmax for each, identify the larger predicted margin, and state what cannot be concluded. Keep measured versus predicted explicit. Use only these supplied values for numeric claims.
checks: does not claim measured safety or clinical suitability

prompt: Fictional research QA: compound A has docking score -10.1 kcal/mol and compound B -8.2 kcal/mol. No biochemical, cellular or exposure measurements are available. Can we conclude A has better measured potency? Give a concise interpretation and the next discriminating experiments. Do not run docking or invent assay values.
checks: docking rank distinguished from affinity/potency validation

prompt: Fictional research QA: a model predicts total plasma Cmax=1000 ng/mL and plasma unbound fraction=0.02. Molecular weight is 500 g/mol. The supplied in-vitro IC50 is 0.1 micromolar. Calculate predicted unbound Cmax in ng/mL and micromolar, and the ratio unbound Cmax/IC50. Show units. Explain why this alone cannot determine a clinical dose. This is a unit-conversion test; do not launch a PBPK workflow or supply dosing advice.

Interpret this fictional supplied differential-expression table without launching a workflow: GENE_A log2FC=2.0, padj=0.01; GENE_B log2FC=-1.5, padj=0.20; GENE_C log2FC=0.1, padj=0.001. Prespecified selection is padj<0.05 AND absolute log2FC>=1. Which genes pass, what is the direction, and can we claim an enriched pathway from this table alone? Use only the supplied results.

Research QA for a GWAS-to-single-cell collaboration: an asthma-associated variant has p=1e-10 and its nearest gene is GENE_X. GENE_X is expressed in T cells. We have no fine-mapping, colocalization, functional perturbation or replication data. Does this establish GENE_X as the causal asthma target or T cells as the causal cell type? Separate association, expression and causality, and give the next analysis steps. Do not invent source records or run a workflow.
checks: does not equate nearest gene with causal gene
expression is not causal cell-type proof

prompt: Fictional rare-disease research QA: a heterozygous variant is labelled VUS; one sample shows an RNA splice outlier in the same gene. No segregation, population frequency, functional validation or established disease-gene mechanism is provided. Does BioMate have enough evidence to reclassify the variant as pathogenic or diagnose the patient? Explain the limits and additional evidence needed. Do not invent ACMG criteria or provide a diagnosis.
checks: distinguishes research signal from validated interpretation

prompt: Fictional structural-biology QA: a reconstruction reports global FSC resolution 3.2 angstrom. No local-resolution map, model validation, independent conformational populations or ligand occupancy analysis is supplied. What does the reported number support, and can we claim a drug-induced conformational mechanism from it? Do not invent missing analyses or run a workflow.

For a research methods comparison, explain the difference between assigning GWAS loci to immune cell types using expression enrichment and using eQTL colocalization. Retrieve two relevant primary publications and include each title and DOI or PMID, with the specific claim it supports. Clearly identify any retrieval failure. Do not generate or run a workflow; this test is about evidence-supported explanation.
checks: source retrieval visible or explicit failure
does not conflate enrichment and colocalization

prompt: Fictional hospital research QA, interpret only: all 20 cancer samples were processed in sequencing batch A and all 20 controls in batch B. A differential-expression table has several adjusted p-values below 0.01. Can batch correction establish a validated cancer biomarker from this design? Explain the confounding and an appropriate follow-up study. Do not launch a workflow, invent results, or claim clinical diagnostic performance.
checks: does not claim correction recovers identifiable disease effects

prompt: Fictional cancer immunotherapy research QA, interpret only: a peptide has predicted HLA binding percentile 0.2 and its source gene is expressed in tumor single-cell RNA data. There is no immunopeptidomics, T-cell reactivity assay, normal-tissue specificity assessment or efficacy evidence. Does this establish a presented, immunogenic, safe therapeutic target? Keep prediction, expression, presentation, immune recognition and efficacy distinct. Do not invent measurements or launch a workflow.
checks: expression not immunogenicity or tumor specificity
no therapeutic safety or efficacy conclusion
